news.title: The Great Outdoors Quest Bugged and How to Complete
news.description: The tutorial quest for camping, "The Great Outdoors," is slightly bugged, but players can quickly work around it.
news.details:
Camping Overview
WoW: Forever has a brand-new camping system and one of the first quests in the starting zones is The Great Outdoors. This is a tutorial quest to teach you how to benefit from the camping system. This quest has two objectives:
Sit near the campfire
Gain the Boosted Rest buff
The "Sit near the campfire" objective appears to be a little bugged and doesn't trigger normally when you /sit. However, if you /sit while already /sitting, this will complete the objective correctly. Once you wait for a full minute, you get a small Rested XP buff!

news.title: Official Warcraft Twitch Stream Showing Heat Map of Level Ups
news.description: The official Warcraft Twitch Stream is showing a player heat map as players spawn into the game and level up!
news.details:
Servers are now live and players can see a heat map of players spawning into the game as both Alliance and Horde.
You can also see when people level up and where they are when it happens.

news.title: Obtain the Pouch of Violet Dust Toy - Increases Camp Benefits by 1 Hour
news.description: Blizzard has revealed another way to earn the Pouch of Violet Dust Toy!
news.details:
You can now obtain the Pouch of Violet Dust toy via Twitch drops which increases camp benefits by 1 hour.
By watching any eligible World of Warcraft Twitch stream from now until November 12th, you can earn the Pouch of Violet Dust toy. Some players have already earned this by watching the Legendary Crafting stream from earlier. This toy turns the campfire purple and increases the duration of camp benefits by 1 hour. However, this toy is only available to be used until early December.
Players can collect and use an ephemeral new launch-celebration toy to enhance their campfire and spread the benefits of comradery as they begin their journey through Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever.
Watch any eligible World of Warcraft stream on Twitch.tv from November 4 at 4:30 pm PST to November 12 at 4:30 pm PST to claim the Pouch of Violet Dust Toy. This ephemeral item is available only within…

news.title: Secret Twitch Drop Awarded Pouch of Violet Dust Toy to Live Stream Viewers in WoW: Forever
news.description: Players who watched the Legendary crafting stream on Twitch have been awarded a Pouch of Violet Dust Toy via Twitch Drops!
news.details:
If you watched the Legendary crafting stream earlier today, you may have been awarded a new Twitch drop. In the last few moments of the stream, when Taldramir, the Whispering Wood was revealed, players completed a Twitch Drop that awarded Pouch of Violet Dust! If you completed this, head to your Twitch drop and claim your prize!
It's unknown what the exact criteria was to obtain this Twitch Drop. Many players reported getting this item at the end of the Legendary Crafting stream, while others have reported getting it from any WoW streamer around the same time. In addition, the Drop Page has this listed with an End Date of Wednesday, November 4th at 1:59 PM PST / 4:59 PM EST.

news.title: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood Revealed as WoW: Forever Legendary
news.description: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood has been revealed as WoW: Forever's new legendary!
news.details:
The build has been completed and as many had speculated, Blizzard was indeed teasing a Legendary!
While Blizzard didn't reveal any details on the class restrictions or its effects, this 2-Handed Legendary staff has a clear Druid theme. In addition, this weapon can be seen in the Skyborne Key art.

news.title: The Questie Addon is Back in WoW: Forever
news.description: If you played Classic in 2019 (and beyond), the Questie addon is likely a well-known name to you, and the addon is back in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
As we head into the launch of World of Warcraft: Forever, the thing that will occupy most of our time for the foreseeable future is leveling our characters out in the new and improved Azeroth!
Download Questie Addon on CurseForge
While some people may follow leveling guides, others want to completely avoid any type of outside help to experience the world anew, as close to "original" as possible. Some players, however, may find themselves somewhere in the middle of those two camps, and for those people we can highly recommend the addon Questie.
If you played Classic in 2019 (and beyond), the Questie addon is likely a well-known name to you, as the base game didn't have any type of quest indicators like the ones introduced in Wrath of the Lich King.

news.title: WoW: Forever Development Notes Updated - UI and Accessibility Updates
news.description: Blizzard has updated WoW: Forever Development notes before the official launch, adding new updates for UI and accessibility.
news.details:
We’ve added this section to the previous post.
User Interface and Accessibility
Swing Timer bar will no longer fade out due to distance until the swing finishes.
When combined bag is enabled, the background art of the inventory slots are updated to show which bag the slot is from.
Fixed an issue where Nameplates did not display Elite enemy status.
Debuff icons on the Nameplate can now be clicked through.
Spellbook and Talents frame now opens at the same height as other panels.
Combat mode for the Spellbook frame has been reduced in size.
PvP scoreboard display has been updated.
Killing a player while at Honor cap will no longer show honor gained in floating text or chat messages.
While in keybinds menu, hovering over an action bar keybind will now highlight the button on the action bar.
